The leaf-leaf quadratic has negative discriminant, and the RK4 scalar polynomial is strictly positive on nonnegative arguments, guaranteeing diagonal positivity by symmetry. The expanded 9A_xC_x-4B_x² certificate is strictly positive using V-x²<= (S-x)², so each edge cubic decreases strictly and crosses zero once. Q_x-Q_y is a negative multiple of the always-positive leaf quadratic for x>y, making the largest spoke first. A stochastic irreducibility/Perron-Frobenius argument forces H<β/λmax for unequal weights, while equal weights yield equality. Independently checked exact rational star matrices and symbolic difference/discriminant identities.
residual_risks: Finite weight/step verification alone does not imply monotonicity on the positive continuum; the polynomial certificates do.

originality.rationale: The October 25 bidirected-star theorem treats arbitrary positive inward rates a_i and outward rates b_i. Its specialization a_i=b_i=w_i has precisely the symmetric weighted star Laplacian and exactly the same coefficients: B=S, S1=V, S2=W, and g_i(h)=Q_{w_i}(h). Its unique first hub-edge zero theorem covers the principal iff positivity result. Ordering by largest w_i and strict spectral separation follow by elementary subtraction and Perron–Frobenius from that earlier exact formula; they do not leave a substantial new result.
